question_text: How many of these petrol containers can be completely filled with $300\text{ L}$ of petrol?

subparts.stem: How many of these petrol containers can be completely filled with $300\text{ L}$ of petrol?

mark_breakdown.desc: Correctly grouping marks into intervals of 10
Accurate tallies and frequencies summing to 30

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Grouped frequency distributions organize continuous or large discrete datasets into non-overlapping class intervals.
step_by_step: Define consistent class intervals from 0-9 to 90-99.
Tally each given score into its corresponding interval.
Sum the tallies to record frequencies and check that the total equals 30.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Placing boundary values in two overlapping intervals if classes are poorly defined.
